_comment: Layer 2 (TypeScript) — the mutation floor. Consumers extend this file. The threshold is never lowered to accommodate a survivor: a survivor is killed by strengthening the test, or proven equivalent and excluded at the narrowest possible node. Note the asymmetry with the PHP side, which is real and not an oversight: Infection has minCoveredMsi, a floor over covered code only, and Stryker has no covered-only break threshold. So TypeScript enforces the STRICTER overall MSI, which a repository built to this standard from day one can hold and a retrofitted one may not.
